```plato
//==
// # Implicit SDF
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Bounded function-valued signed distance fields
//  - Placed signed distance fields
//  - Function-valued implicit shapes
//  - Metaballs
//  - SDF modifiers
//  - Sampled signed distance fields
//  - SDF combination trees

//=
// # Bounded function-valued signed distance fields
//
// Analytic SDFs packaged with a conservative AABB for culling, tiling, and
// CSG acceleration. Bounds do not change distance evaluation: Eval /
// DistanceAt always delegate to the inner FunctionSdf. Prefer loose bounds
// over tight ones — incorrect tight bounds cause false culls.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds.
// Related: `SignedDistanceField*` / `BoundedSignedDistanceField*` in
// `implicit-sdf.concepts.plato`; sampled lattices with Bounds below; operators
// in `implicit-sdf.library.plato`.

// A planar function SDF with a conservative bounding rectangle. Outside
// Bounds the solid may be treated as empty for culling; the stored distance
// function is still evaluated on request.
type BoundedSdf2D
    implements IValue, IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D, IDifferentiableSignedDistanceField2D
{
    Sdf: FunctionSdf2D;
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
}
```
